id: title:Gilbert09:suppress adminshutdown capture in best effort shutdown lease release

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces false-positive error tracking and alert fatigue during warehouse maintenance or failover by distinguishing expected shutdown exceptions from unexpected failures.
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 adds a check before reporting an exception during shutdown. If the exception is identified as an admin shutdown, it logs a warning instead of calling capture_exception. This could prevent false-positive error tracking and alert fatigue for expected, non-fatal connection terminations during warehouse maintenance or failover, while still distinguishing unexpected failures. P
review.uncertainty: The exact classification behavior relies on an external helper `_is_admin_shutdown_error` not supplied in this chunk, so the precise implementation and its effectiveness are not demonstrated. No tests or documentation are provided in this chunk to establish tier or benefit.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a production implementation change. P1.F2.H1 is a test implementation. The score and connection must be derived from P1.F1.H1. P1.F2.H1 does not establish tier or benefit, only that the implementation is tested.

observations.behavior: Adds a check before reporting an exception during shutdown. If the exception is an admin shutdown, it logs a warning instead of an exception and does not call capture_exception.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent false-positive error tracking and alert fatigue for expected, non-fatal connection terminations during warehouse maintenance or failover, while still distinguishing unexpected failures. The implementation relies on an external helper _is_admin_shutdown_error not supplied in this chunk, so the exact classification behavior is not demonstrated.
